# Mani Sai Teja Bejjala - Portfolio

> Hardware-Informed Frontend & Full Stack Developer | IIIT Sri City

## About
Mani Sai Teja Bejjala is a Full-Stack Engineer and Hardware Enthusiast specializing in React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and System Architecture.

## Key Projects
- **Portfolio Website**: Interactive developer portfolio built with React, Vite, Framer Motion, and Tailwind CSS.
- **Hardware & Software Integrations**: Projects integrating low-level hardware awareness with modern front-end interfaces.

## Core Skills & Technologies
- **Frontend**: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Vite, Zustand
- **Backend & Tooling**: Node.js, REST APIs, SonarCloud, Chrome DevTools, Git
